definitions.gloss: Japanese style; in the Japanese manner
definitions.explanation: Having characteristics typical of Japanese aesthetics, design, or customs. Used as a noun or as a modifier with の to describe things done in a Japanese way.

examples.japanese: {日本風|にほんふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日本風|にほんふう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建|た}てられている→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: This building was constructed in the Japanese style.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{日本風|にほんふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese-style curry is gaining popularity at overseas restaurants.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧ (Japan) + {風|ふう} (style, manner). The suffix {風|ふう} is highly productive and attaches to country names, proper nouns, and other words to mean 'in the style of.' Can be used as a noun or as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本風|にほんふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: Japanese-style house
- {日本風|にほんふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: Japanese-style cooking
- {日本風|にほんふう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦アレンジ→アレンジ：08148_arenji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to arrange in the Japanese style

SIMILAR PATTERNS WITH {風|ふう}:
- {西洋風|せいようふう}: Western style
- {中華風|ちゅうかふう}: Chinese style
- ⟦{洋風|ようふう}→洋風：13282_youfuu⟧: Western/European style
- ⟦{和風|わふう}→和風：12034_wafuu⟧: Japanese style (more common synonym using the {和|わ} prefix)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{和風|わふう}→和風：12034_wafuu⟧: Japanese style -- more commonly used in everyday contexts, especially for food and design
- ⟦{日本式|にほんしき}→日本式：28462_nihonshiki⟧: Japanese method/system -- emphasizes the system or method rather than aesthetic style
- {和様|わよう}: Japanese style -- literary/formal, used for architecture and calligraphy
